scripts.build: xcodebuild -scheme Whisky -configuration Release -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='-' CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build 2>&1 | xcbeautify
scripts.start: open $(xcodebuild -scheme Whisky -configuration Release -showBuildSettings 2>/dev/null | grep ' BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR' | head -1 | awk '{print $3}')/Whisky.app
